messages.subject: Hierarchical spatial modeling workshop, Switzerland, June 2024
parts:
Dear all,

here is an advert that is not strictly and directly relevant to unmarked, so sorry for that. However, it is somewhat spiritually related, so here we go:

From 24-27 June 2024, Jeff Doser, Gesa von Hirschheydt, and I will teach a 4-day workshop at the Swiss Ornithological Institute in Sempach, Switzerland, on "Hierarchical spatial modelling for applied population and community ecology". In this workshop, we will present highly scalable (*) approaches for hierarchical Bayesian spatial modelling of species distributions and abundance with a focus on practical implementation of the models using the new spOccupancy and spAbundance R packages.

Please see the attached flyer for more information about the course and for how to apply.

Kind regards,

Marc

(*) This is stats slang for a situation when an ecologist would say something like "works also for very big data sets"
